meta.parties: Peduru Fernando Et Al. v. Mary Fernando Et Al

rules.statement: A deed of gift creates a valid fidei commissum extending to four generations if the donor intended it and certain conditions are met.
rules.supporting_quote: "The learned District Judge dismissed the plaintiff's action holding that P 1 had not been accepted and that it did not create a valid fidei commissum. It is well settled law that no donation is complete and valid unless it is accepted by the donee."
